# LushLands Management

> LushLands Management is property management software for landlords and property managers in any country.

LushLands is web software for keeping a property portfolio in one account: properties, the people who own or occupy them, maintenance, and payments. The screens are in English. The product is not built for one country. It is a record-keeping tool. It does not act as a lawyer, accountant, broker, or local property manager, and it does not give legal, tax, or financial advice. You follow the housing, privacy, and tax rules that apply where you operate.

It is for landlords, owners, letting agents, and property managers, including people whose rentals are in a different country from where they live.

You can save property and occupant records, log maintenance and keep a priority on each request, and record rent and other charges. Card payments are processed by Stripe. LushLands does not store the full card number and does not hold a bank account for you. A free plan includes up to 5 properties, plus occupant, maintenance, and payment records, and up to 5 audio clips and 1 video message a month generated from text you supply. Premium is 15 US dollars a month, has no property limit, and removes those monthly audio and video caps. Generated audio and video can be wrong, so check them before you send them to anyone.

Sign-in, payment, checkout, and private dashboard addresses are not public pages and are left out of this file.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.lushlandsmanagement.com/): Public overview of the software, who it is for, and the core records
- [Welcome](https://www.lushlandsmanagement.com/welcome): Landlord-focused introduction, features, and the free and Premium plans
- [FAQ](https://www.lushlandsmanagement.com/faq): Questions about features, plans, payments, audio, and local law
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.lushlandsmanagement.com/terms): Terms for using the software
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.lushlandsmanagement.com/privacy): How account data, property records, Stripe payments, and generated audio are handled
- [Disclaimer](https://www.lushlandsmanagement.com/disclaimer): The product is not legal, financial, or tax advice
- [How to Track Rent Payments as a Landlord](https://www.lushlandsmanagement.com/guides/track-rent-payments): How landlords can track rent payments: what to record, a seven-step system, handling late rent and a monthly checklist.
- [Rental Property Maintenance Log Template](https://www.lushlandsmanagement.com/guides/maintenance-log-template): A rental property maintenance log template for landlords: what to record, how to set priorities and a simple repairs process.
- [How to Keep Tenant Records as a Landlord](https://www.lushlandsmanagement.com/guides/tenant-records): What landlords should keep in tenant records, how to organise them, handling personal data responsibly and a simple template.
- [Property Management Software for Letting Agents](https://www.lushlandsmanagement.com/guides/property-management-for-letting-agents): What letting agents need from property management software, how to set up a system and a weekly review for property managers.
